instruction: Use AutoCAD. Open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\cli_blank_seed.dxf. Start from cli_blank_seed.dxf. Draw a 200 x 120 drawing frame on OUTLINE, a title block rectangle from (130,0) to (200,25), divider lines from (130,12.5) to (200,12.5) and from (165,0) to (165,25), add text ACAD-21 on ANNOTATION, and keep all geometry in autocad_result.dxf. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder.
